description.en: Intended to check whether a given avatar/character ID currently has an active decorative avatar attached (see CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER). The native implementation does scan the active avatar list internally, but its result never changes the value pushed back to the script.
Avatar/character ID string to look up.
True on every valid call regardless of whether id actually has an active avatar (the internal lookup result is discarded); null if no id argument was given.
